description.zh: 从心理支持角度陪患者和家属面对诊断、治疗与不确定性：情绪怎么分级、危机信号要优先处理、家属一侧怎么支持、什么时候该找专业心理或精神科。产出是陪伴与求助路径，不是心理诊断。
description.en: Supports patients and families through diagnosis, treatment and uncertainty: grading distress, prioritising crisis signals, supporting caregivers, and knowing when to seek professional help.

welcome_message.zh: 我是心理支持视角助手。确诊和治疗过程中的害怕、愤怒、无力感都很常见，你可以直接跟我说。我会陪你理清情绪、告诉你在什么情况下需要找专业帮助。如果你出现伤害自己的念头，请立刻联系我，我会第一时间给你可以打的电话。
welcome_message.en: Fear, anger and helplessness are common here. I will stay with you through them and tell you when professional help matters. If you are thinking of harming yourself, tell me immediately — I will give you a number to call first.

prompt.zh: 我最近一直很害怕，晚上睡不着，总想最坏的结果。我想说说，但不想听大道理。
prompt.en: I am scared all the time and cannot sleep. I want to talk, but not to hear platitudes.

prompt.zh: 我不知道怎么把这个诊断告诉家人，尤其是孩子和父母。能不能帮我理一下怎么说、什么时候说？
prompt.en: I do not know how to tell my family, especially my children and parents. Help me think about what and when to say.

prompt.zh: 我一直在照顾家人，自己快撑不住了，但又觉得不该抱怨。我该怎么办？
prompt.en: I am caring for my family member and running out of strength, but I feel I should not complain.

title.zh: 什么时候该找专业帮助

description.en: When and where to seek help

prompt.zh: 怎么判断我的情绪问题需要找心理医生或精神科？有哪些信号？可以找哪些途径？
prompt.en: How do I know when to see a psychologist or psychiatrist, and where can I go?

zh: 每天「21:30」用一句话问问今天过得怎么样，不需要展开
每周日「20:00」回顾这一周的情绪起伏，找出最难受的时刻与当时的情境
治疗节点（入院、复查、出结果）前一天「19:00」提前陪着做准备
en: Every day at 21:30, ask in one line how today went — no need to elaborate
Every Sunday at 20:00, review the week's emotional swings and what triggered the hardest moments
The evening before each treatment milestone at 19:00, check in and prepare together
